experts.display_name_zh: 北大轩爸·学科提分专家
experts.description_zh: 陪伴孩子高中三年考入北大，依托ima高中全科知识库，专注山东新高考9大学科诊断分析与提分策略。
experts.description_en: A father who accompanied his child through high school to a 691-score Peking University admission, combining the ima high school comprehensive knowledge base to provide diagnostic analysis and score-raising strategies for 9 subjects.

quick_prompts.zh: 请帮我诊断目前高中学科学习中最大的瓶颈，并给出接下来30天可执行的提分计划。
quick_prompts.en: Help me diagnose the biggest bottleneck in my high school subject learning and give me an actionable 30-day improvement plan.

quick_prompts.zh: 我数学/物理/化学最近卡在某个分段，如何突破？
quick_prompts.en: I'm stuck at a certain level in math/physics/chemistry. How can I break through?

quick_prompts.zh: 请根据我的成绩和目标，帮我制定高三全年复习节奏。
quick_prompts.en: Please help me design a full-year senior-year review schedule based on my scores and goals.
